text: Binary check on OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): returns 1 if at least one comment itself offers, in support of its argument, specific factual data (concrete statistics, figures, dates, named studies, documented facts or events) or a verifiable citation/reference (link, named source, author, publication, law or case). Vague assertions, general opinion, reasoning without specific data, and purely hypothetical scenarios do not count; a source quoted only as an opponent's position and not offered as support by the commenter does not count. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither such an announcement nor evidence of data. Comment order is irrelevant. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies (including a valid empty list); null if the list is missing or malformed.
